chunks.text:
[Intro]
{a warm music-box statement of the first notes of the hometown theme over a soft string chord, then a drum pickup steps out onto the road}
positive_styles: G major moving to C major
plucked harp arpeggios as the thread through every section
grateful, nostalgic, warm and a little teary

chunks.text:
[The First Road]
{a springy walking melody in G major, bright and adventurous, the first road out of town remembered}
positive_styles: G major moving to C major
plucked harp arpeggios as the thread through every section
grateful, nostalgic, warm and a little teary

chunks.text:
[The Glowing Wood]
{a dreamy wondering melody in G Lydian with a raised fourth, glistening harp and bells, lighter drums, the glowing forest remembered}
positive_styles: G major moving to C major
plucked harp arpeggios as the thread through every section
grateful, nostalgic, warm and a little teary

chunks.text:
[The Cold Miles]
{contrast: drums fall silent, a slow suspended melody in F minor on strings and soft lead, the long cold miles remembered, bittersweet}
positive_styles: G major moving to C major
plucked harp arpeggios as the thread through every section
grateful, nostalgic, warm and a little teary

chunks.text:
[The Turn]
{the harmony rises out of the minor through a G dominant, the harp climbing, drums returning, the dawn answering}
positive_styles: G major moving to C major
plucked harp arpeggios as the thread through every section
grateful, nostalgic, warm and a little teary

chunks.text:
[Home in Daylight]
{the hometown lullaby theme reprised whole in radiant C major, full warm band, bells crowning; the last bar settles on a half cadence that leads straight back into the walking theme, no ending}
positive_styles: G major moving to C major
plucked harp arpeggios as the thread through every section
grateful, nostalgic, warm and a little teary
seamless loop back to the start of the walking theme
